methodology: Long-horizon suite B (compaction matrix): same recency-trap session as A, but the raw baseline is replaced by baseline-compact — when context exceeds max_context it drops oldest spans (keeping only the system prompt when possible), forcing a full re-prefill of survivors. DynCLM and immediate-rewrite (CLM) use the same max_context for the scheduler β threshold and reclaim via soft-invalidation + rewrite instead of blind truncation. Matrix over max_context ∈ {8k,16k,32k,64k}. Noise is sized so cumulative appends exceed the largest limit, ensuring baseline-compact must compact at every limit.
